meta.name: clinvar-annotation
meta.description: Guide for annotating ENCODE regulatory variants with ClinVar clinical significance. Use when users need to check if variants in ENCODE peaks have clinical associations, find pathogenic variants in regulatory regions, or assess variant clinical impact. Trigger on: ClinVar, clinical significance, pathogenic variant, variant classification, clinical variant, disease variant, VUS, benign, likely pathogenic.

copy.tagline: 查询调控区域变异与临床意义的关联
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在ENCODE调控区域中查找ClinVar临床相关变异
copy.tagline_en: Annotate regulatory variants with ClinVar clinical significance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find clinically relevant variants in ENCODE regulatory regions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你查询 ClinVar 数据库中变异与疾病的关联，并与 ENCODE 调控元件（如增强子、启动子）交叉分析，找出位于调控区域的致病或意义未明变异，评估其调控影响。
howto.when: 当你提到“ClinVar”、“致病变异”、“临床意义”等关键词，或要求检查 ENCODE 峰中的变异是否有临床关联时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下胰腺 H3K27ac 峰里有没有 ClinVar 致病变异。
INS 基因的 ClinVar 致病变异有哪些？
chr11:2159000-2162000 区域有哪些 ClinVar 变异？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query ClinVar for variant-disease associations and cross-reference them with ENCODE regulatory elements (e.g., enhancers, promoters) to identify pathogenic or VUS variants in regulatory regions and assess their regulatory impact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ClinVar", "pathogenic variant", "clinical significance", or ask to check variants in ENCODE peaks for clinical associations.

say_en.text: Check for ClinVar pathogenic variants in pancreas H3K27ac peaks.
List ClinVar pathogenic variants in the INS gene.
say_en.note: Claude will query ClinVar via E-utilities for INS gene pathogenic variants.

say_en.text: What ClinVar variants are in chr11:2159000-2162000?
say_en.note: Claude will query ClinVar variants in that genomic region.
